faces.name: The Best of Both Worlds
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Assimilate target nonartifact creature an opponent controls. (Gain control of it and put a +1/+1 counter on it. It's a Borg artifact creature and loses all other creature types.)
II — Artifact creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
III — Exile the Borg assimilated with this Saga, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.

faces.name: The Biblioplex
faces.oracleText:
{T}: Add {C}.
{2}, {T}: Look at the top card of your library. If it's an instant or sorcery card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, you may put it into your graveyard. Activate only if you have exactly zero or seven cards in hand.

faces.name: The Big Aquarium
faces.oracleText:
Marine animals can't block or be blocked by non-marine animals. (Marine animals live in the ocean or other salt- water environments.)
Whenever you attack, for each player you're attacking, create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token that's tapped and attacking that player. If chaos ensued this turn, instead create a 5/5 blue Whale Shark creature token that's tapped and attacking that player.

faces.name: The Big Idea
faces.oracleText:
{2}{B/R}{B/R}, {T}: Roll a six-sided die. Create a number of 1/1 red Brainiac creature tokens equal to the result.
Tap three untapped Brainiacs you control: The next time you would roll a six-sided die, instead roll two six-sided dice and use the total of those results.

faces.name: The Big Top
faces.oracleText: {T}: Add one mana of any color that appears on your top. (A top is an outerwear garment worn on the upper body.)

faces.name: The Binding of the Titans
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Each player mills three cards.
II — Exile up to two target cards from graveyards. For each creature card exiled this way, you gain 1 life.
III — Return target creature or land card from your graveyard to your hand.

faces.name: The Bird Champion
faces.oracleText:
Defender, flying
At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 green and blue Bird creature token with flying for each Bird you control.
As long as you control twelve or more Birds, you can't lose the game and opponents can't win the game.
